# tcpshield_user (Data Source)

The TCPShield account the API key belongs to — plan, limits and contact details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_user" "me" {}

output "plan" {
  value = data.tcpshield_user.me.plan_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account_limited` (Boolean) Whether the account is limited.
- `balance` (String) Account balance, as the API reports it.
- `commit_level` (String) Commit level, empty when none.
- `created_at` (String) Account creation timestamp.
- `email` (String) Login email.
- `firstname` (String) First name.
- `id` (Number) Numeric user id.
- `lastname` (String) Last name.
- `phone` (String) Phone number.
- `plan_expiry` (String) When the current plan period ends.
- `plan_id` (Number) Numeric plan id.
- `plan_name` (String) Plan name, e.g. `Pro`.
- `two_factor_enabled` (Boolean) Whether two-factor authentication is on.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether the account's email is verified.
